g.text: Option Desk - Prompt construction and the optional model boundary
Rules require artifact-grounded answers, degradation first,
correct units, visible missing values and model limitations.
These are prompt instructions, not a proof that every model obeys.
question -> proposed tool name and arguments.
The bounded graph does not call that router or let a model
choose its calculation stages. Its optional model summarizes.
Sources: agent/src/optiondesk_agent/prompts.py and graph.py. A prompt helper does not execute a tool.
